title: 听力挑战 · 复盘项目进度

rounds.speaker: 项目经理
rounds.line: Where are we with the project right at this moment?
rounds.lineCn: 项目此刻进展到什么阶段了?

grammar.name: 现在完成时与进行时综合
grammar.note: 已经完成的动作用现在完成时,正在进行的用现在进行时。

options.text: We have finished the design and are testing it.
options.feedback: 完成时加进行时准确描述当前进度。

options.text: We will finish the design tomorrow.
options.feedback: 与'已经完成设计'的现状矛盾。

options.text: We finished the design next week.
options.feedback: next week 与过去时搭配,时态混乱。

rounds.speaker: 项目经理
rounds.line: Why was the product launch delayed again this week, Jane?
rounds.lineCn: 简,这周产品发布为什么又延期了?

grammar.name: 过去时与完成时综合
grammar.note: 过去时描述已经发生的事件,完成时说明持续到现在的状态。

options.text: The team has been waiting for the final data.
options.feedback: 现在完成进行时说明等待持续至今,解释合理。

options.text: The team waits for data every morning.
options.feedback: 一般现在时谈习惯,不能解释本次延期。

options.text: The launch was delayed last year.
options.feedback: 混淆延期时间,答非所问。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: What has changed since the last project meeting we had?
rounds.lineCn: 自上项目会议以来有什么变化?

grammar.name: 完成时对比
grammar.note: 先完成的动作用过去完成时,对现在有影响的用现在完成时。

options.text: We had solved the old issue, but a new one has appeared.
options.feedback: 过去完成时加现在完成时对比,变化说明清楚。

options.text: We will solve the issue after the meeting.
options.feedback: 将来时与'已解决旧问题'的事实不符。
与旧问题已解决的现状矛盾。
